title: Show HN: didtheywinornot.com Single Purpose Scores Site
guide_zh: 不想看复杂比分，只想知道赢没赢，这个小站先从棒球结果做起。
author: apgwoz
excerpt: I built didtheywinornot.com this week in my spare hours before work. Currently it only does baseball scores, but as new seasons start in the fall, I think I'll expand it to other sports. Would love some feedback and any ideas as to how to make it better, keeping in mind that this is meant to be single purpose and not at all bloated. Did I miss a stat that people really care about? Is the amount of information good enough?
